recommendation: Keep the fix. It restores the substantive consistency rule from FHIR-45034 while preserving later FHIR-48101 invariant cleanup and FHIR-40273 DocumentReference support. Any checked-in generated diagram refresh should be handled separately or by the normal publishing process.
issue_request: FHIR-45034 was an Applied/Persuasive Imaging Integration change request asking how ImagingSelection.studyUid and ImagingSelection.derivedFrom relate when both are present. The final resolution changed derivedFrom to 0..1 and added studyUid guidance tying it to the referenced ImagingStudy identifier.
initial_application: PR 3221 / commit 3f26655a0d9c9b69dc90dba10dc5a89ed7f8c2fa initially applied the issue by changing derivedFrom max from * to 1 and adding the studyUid match requirement. The current source still retained derivedFrom 0..1, but later FHIR-48101 edits removed the entire studyUid requirements value and dropped the match guidance.
additional_context: ImagingSelection is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-48101 later replaced confusing required-unless text with invariants, so the reconciliation restored only the match rule and not the removed existence prose. FHIR-40273 supports retaining DocumentReference as a derivedFrom target, and FHIR-54814 later confirms derivedFrom references ImagingStudy when images were selected from it. FHIR-47964, a cardinality-only follow-on based on FHIR-45034, is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Added a focused requirements value to ImagingSelection.studyUid in source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml stating that when ImagingSelection.derivedFrom references an ImagingStudy, the studyUid value, if present, must match an identifier of that ImagingStudy.
source_changes: source/imagingselection/structuredefinition-ImagingSelection.xml: restored a requirements value on ImagingSelection.studyUid for matching a referenced ImagingStudy identifier when derivedFrom references ImagingStudy.
